description: This file defines the 'Project' class as a data entity with properties mapped to a database table 'project'. It includes foreign key relationships, data annotations for validation, and some enum definitions related to project visibility and vulnerability metrics.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Represents a project entity with properties such as Id, Name, Description, dates, and foreign key references to user, organization, and category entities. It inherits from TimestampedEntity and includes data annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: Visibility
classes.description: Enum indicating the visibility scope of a project, either Public or Private.

classes.name: VulnerabilityMetrics
classes.description: Enum representing types of vulnerability metrics, such as CVSS and OWASP_RR.
